findings.description: Genus iff, duplicate source voices, contextual noncollapse, recorded-state immutability and opaque printed positive/nonentailment precedence need owner review.
Per-event unique subject revision/Contract relation and selected functions need accepted exact version/Entity/counterpart maps; no global uniqueness or challenger singleton inferred.
Equality of opaque payload Tokens at recorded states is not complete byte/trace/time immutability; initial/recorded-state coverage and revision-versus-business-event identity unaccepted.
Attributable/eligible and recorded contestation need real identity/standing/Contract/Policy/subject authentication; stated grounds/evidence are not validity or truth.
Own subject/revision, contradiction Finding, resolution, Decision and automatic transition differ; Event can be another Event's subject. Current carrier/global identity maps unaccepted.
Response/disposition/residue overlays and successor record revisions differ from immutable filing revision; actual gates/causal/timing/subject effects unverified.
Dedicated admitted carrier, permissive state/time/ref/evidence and embedded roles, stored candidate record chain and inspected service syntax do not establish whole conformance/runtime proof.
Thirty-six authored uses and current comparisons lack accepted edge completeness, common meaning and source-owner formal-translation fidelity.
